contract.name: prior-close-decision_next-close-fill_long-flat_v1
contract.sizing: All affordable continuous units on entry; hold units until exit; no ongoing rebalancing
contract.signal_availability: Decision uses only the prefix through close[t]; earliest fill is close[t+1]
contract.fee_basis: fee_bps/10000 times actual fill price times absolute executed quantity
contract.equity_observation: Cash plus units marked at the unadjusted close, after the close fill
contract.held_observation: Incoming held state over the interval ending at the current close, before its fill
contract.terminal_rule: Predeclared liquidation at penultimate real close; final real row settles delayed bookkeeping

worker.measurement_policy: Untimed preflight precedes independent fresh timed worker; each timed result is checked outside its timed region

protocol.balanced_blocks: Rotate engine order by block index; reverse it for odd-indexed strategies; alternate strategy order between blocks. Mirrored two-strategy cases balance mean engine position jointly; five blocks cover only five of seven positions within each strategy.
protocol.garbage_collection: Explicit gc.collect before each call is outside its timed interval; collections triggered during calls remain included
protocol.scope_warning: Full engines perform different native extra work; engine_scope and settings must accompany comparisons. Native-component and internal-core calls never receive full-engine ratios.

input.normalization: Original prices unchanged; close event timestamp derived from declared source interval semantics
input.venue_provenance: Byte identity only unless an external data manifest establishes more
